title: Argentinian Beef Empanadas
description: A classic South American pastry filled with seasoned beef, onions, and spices. Perfect for a casual dinner or snack.
instructions: In a large pan, heat 1 tablespoon of olive oil over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until translucent, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute.
Add the ground beef and cook, breaking it up with a spoon, until browned, about 5 minutes.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Roll out the pastry dough to a thickness of 1/8 inch.
Cut out circles of dough using a cookie cutter or the rim of a glass.
Place a tablespoon of beef mixture in the center of each dough circle.
Brush the edges of the dough with light olive oil and fold the pastry in half to form a triangle.
Press the edges together to seal the empanada.
Brush the tops of the empanadas with light olive oil and bake for 20-25 minutes, or until golden brown.
